periods.time: Night at Akatsuki Academy underground training ground

name.zh: 珠雫水色轮回击败华伦斯坦
name.en: Shizuku defeats Wallenstein with Water Rebirth

periods.summary: Wallenstein beats Alice for betraying Akatsuki and plans to kill Shizuku in front of him. His friction manipulation nullifies Shizuku's water attacks and lets his sword cut through her defenses, eventually bisecting her. At the edge of death Shizuku activates Water Rebirth, turning her body into vapor and reconstructing it. In vapor form she bypasses Wallenstein's external friction defense, fills his lungs with water, forms ice spears inside his body, and defeats him. She then embraces Alice, still calling him her sister.
periods.cause: Shizuku follows Alice's magic trace into the underground arena and refuses to abandon him despite his assassin past.
periods.outcome: Wallenstein is incapacitated, Alice is rescued, and Alice accepts that he can remain beside Shizuku.
periods.significance: Shizuku gains a high-risk defensive transformation that fixes her close-range vulnerability and resolves Alice's redemption arc.
